summary: Unilever PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing a new share buyback program of up to €1.5 billion, commencing April 30, 2026, and ending on or before July 6, 2026. The program aims to reduce capital under existing board authority, with a maximum of 223,263,040 shares. Repurchases will be executed through non-discretionary instructions with Morgan Stanley & Co. International PLC, which makes trading decisions independently. Weekly announcements of repurchases are expected. This is a routine capital return without a premium or fixed price per share. Watch for weekly buyback volumes and any early completion.
